review.headline: Easy 9 km done at 5:46/km and HR 139, squarely inside the easy band and matching the plan.
observations: Distance 8.999 km against a 9.0 km plan; all nine km splits held 5:46/km (345-346 s) with no drift.
Average HR 139 (max 142) sits in the conversational range and is in line with recent easy runs (137-140 bpm).
Pace of 5:46/km is within the 5:11-6:13/km easy band and slightly quicker than the 4-week easy average of 5:47/km, which is consistent with a relaxed effort.
Cadence 174 spm and efficiency 1.249 are steady with the previous easy runs, so there are no signs of fatigue.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so subjective effort is unknown.
Weekly volume is well behind plan (24.8 of 43.4 km in week 3), and the athlete has not logged a run since 21 Nov, so the training block is at risk of falling further behind.
